sources.title: Unlimited OCR_Baiduwiki - 百度百科
sources.snippet: Unlimited OCR is an open-source OCR model developed by Baidu based on the DeepSeek OCR technology. Its original development purpose was to address the core bottlenecks of memory and speed degradation in long-document OCR processing.

sources.snippet: Unlimited-OCR is an open-source optical character recognition model developed by Baidu and released on June 22, 2026.
